My Dear Students,

        It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to our esteemed institution.

At the very outset, I extend my warm greetings to all aspiring students who seek to
become a part of this academic community. Choosing the right institution is a
defining step in one’s life, and I assure you that here, you will find not only quality

development.

      Our institution stands firmly on the pillars of academic excellence, integrity,

equally dedicated to continuously evolving and adapting to the changing demands

      I would like to make it clear that along with opportunities come
responsibilities. We expect every student to uphold the values of sincerity, respect,
and hard work. Discipline and regular engagement in academic activities are not
merely encouraged but are essential for personal growth and success.

      I warmly welcome you to join us in this journey of learning and
transformation, and I look forward to seeing you grow into responsible, capable,
and compassionate individuals.

                                 About the College
       Science College, Kokrajhar was established in 1995 and is located in the Bhatarmari
area of Kokrajhar town. The college is affiliated with Bodoland University and is recognized
by the University Grants Commission (UGC), New Delhi, Government of India, under
Sections 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act, 1956 (No. F. 8-381/2005 (PPP-I); visit
www.ugc.ac.in). It is also recognized and provincialized by the Department of Higher
Education, Government of Assam. Furthermore, the college has been accredited with a ‘B’
Grade by NAAC, securing a CGPA of 2.07 in its second cycle.

       The college was established with the active cooperation and selfless dedication of the
local community, beginning with 17 students in the Higher Secondary Science stream.
Classes were initially conducted in the morning shift at the temporary premises of
Rastrabhasha Vidyapeeth School, Kokrajhar. On 26th July 1996, the foundation stone of the
college building was laid by Mr. Rajendra Kumar Mushahary, the then State Minister for
WPT & BC, Assam. The Degree (B.Sc.) courses were subsequently introduced in 1999.

      The institution extends its heartfelt gratitude to Mr. Partha Sarathi
Bhattacharjee, Mr. Phanindra Narayan Ray, Mr. Rukendra Nath Brahma, Late Kamal
Kumar Brahma, and Dr. Ramananda Sinha, the former and founder Principal of
Science College for their relentless efforts to build up the College. Since its inception,
the College has grown in leaps and bounds and has created an atmosphere in
Science Education.

       In just a span of 30 years of glorious existence, the college has grown up as
an Institute of significance for the students of the entire Bodoland Territorial Region
as well as the other parts of Assam. As a co-educational institute, the college has
nine departments viz. Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Computer
Science, Information Technology, Physiotherapy and Languages.                           1

session.

3. Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT)
        The Bachelor of Physiotherapy program is offered by Science College, Kokrajhar is
structured in accordance with the guidelines of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare
Professions (NCAHP). The program is taught by duly qualified faculty and is designed to provide a
systematic integration of academic instructions and supervised clinical training., ensuring the
development of requisite knowledge, skills, and professional competences in the field of
physiotherapy.
Eligibility criteria for application: Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Science) with Physics,
Chemistry and Biology (PCB) with minimum 50% marks.

                    General Rule & Information for the Students

▪ It is mandatory to wear prescribed college uniform and also to carry I-card all the times while
  inside campus and on Uniform off days students must wear decent dress and display the I-Card.

▪ Attendance in classes is compulsory, 75% attendance is the minimum criteria to sit in
  examination.

▪ The students have to comply with the Registration of course, Rules and orders as prescribed by
  the College authority from time to time.

▪ All the students has to participate in all the programmes or activities organized by College
  authority in academic matter.

▪ All forms of ragging inside the College campus is strictly prohibited. Strong disciplinary action
  may be taken if any one is found to be involved directly or indirectly in ragging.

▪ In case of damages or loss of College property, the College authority reserves the right to impose
  fines either individually or on per capita basis.

▪ Gossiping and loitering either in the verandah or the class room are strictly prohibited when
  classes or examinations are going on.

▪ Regularity and punctuality in classes must be maintained. Irregularities, misbehaviour,
  disobedience towards the teachers and or authority and unlawful activities in any form may
  invite strong disciplinary action .

▪ Student found involved in consumption of drugs, intoxicating drinks, glam bins or any other
  immoral activities will be expelled from the College.

▪ Fees to be paid by the students according to the dates notified by authority from time to time.

▪ Violation of rules and regulations and committing any offence which will jeopardize the interest
  and smooth administration of the college, will lead to severe punishment.

▪ Postering or writing on the walls or blackboards of the college is strictly prohibited.

▪ The decision of the competent authority is the final in all matters related to discipline and is
  binding to all the student.

1. Library: Kamal Kumar Brahma Central Library
        The Science college Central Library was established in 1996 with a single room and now
flourish with a separate floor along with all modern library amenities.. The Central Library is named
as Kamal Kumar Brahma Central Library in honour of Kamal Kumar Brahma, an eminent scholar.
The library is automated using SOUL 2.0.9 and RFID technology. The library is known for its
excellent collection of text and reference books, journals, and digital resources. It is well-equipped
with modern facilities such as computers, internet connectivity and scanners.

        This centrally AC library has spacious reading room with comfortable seating arrangements
for students and faculty. The library has an open access system that allows users to browse and select
books from the shelves themselves. The library has a collection of over 12,000 books on various
subjects . The library also has a dedicated website (https://sites.google.com/view/kkbcl) to access
several online databases such as JSTOR, ScienceDirect, and NLIST, NDLI , Doaj etc, which provide
full-text access to thousands of academic journals and research papers.
       The library has a digital library section that houses a collection of e-books, e-journals, and
other digital resources. The digital library provides remote access to online resources to the users.
The library has also established an institutional repository that archives and preserves the research
output of the college faculty members.
Library Staff
The library has a dedicated team of staff who are always ready to assist users in finding and

                                     Department of Physics
        Physics, the science that studies Nature, Natural Phenomena, matter, and energy in their varied forms,
has a very long history. It dates back to prehistoric times, when observation of the heavens was driven by both
navigational needs and religious motivations. Physics proper at that time was indistinguishable from philosophy.
The birth of Physics as a modern natural science is traditionally equated with the work of Galileo Galilei (1564 –
1642), who is credited with putting Physics on an experimental basis, and with insisting that the comparison
with the actual behaviour of nature must be the ultimate check for all concepts and theories within Physics.
         The Department of Physics at Science College Kokrajhar is a dedicated centre Striving for excellence
and committed to quality teaching, holistic education, innovative research, and a vibrant environment. The
department was established in 1995 along with the college and is currently affiliated with Bodoland University.
The Department offers B.Sc. Physics (6 semesters), B.Sc. Physics with Honours or B.Sc. Physics with Honours
and Research (8 semesters) and Physics course for Higher Secondary. The Department seeks to cultivate deep
interest in Physics, motivate students for advance study and research. The department provides hands-on
exposure to software like FORTRAN, C++, MATLAB, Scilab, Python, and LaTeX. Department have
collaborations with several reputed institutes and research centres like IASST, Guwahati; IMD, Pune; RARS,
Gossaigaon, Kokrajhar Planetarium, Kokrajhar etc. The department is proud to have highly qualified,
experienced, and dedicated faculty members who are passionate about teaching and research. They connect
research with classroom activities and involve students. Research interest of the faculty members include
atmospheric science, time series data analysis, Nonlinear dynamics, study the interstellar medium of astronomy
and astrophysics, Material Science, Computational Physics, etc.
        Infrastructure includes a staff office, Digital Class Rooms, Laboratories with computers and Wi-Fi
access.
General Lab: This lab is equipped with Audio Visual Aids (such as OHP, LCD projector), charts, and Models.
Almost all the Thermodynamic and electrical devices used in B.Sc. honours and B.Sc. general courses.
Electronics Lab: This lab have all the electronics kits (like, 8085 microprocessor, Digital lab trainer, Op-Amps,
etc.) components, computers (i.e., desktop and Laptop), Test and measuring devices (like CROs, Signal
Generators, Analog and Digital Meters, etc.) are available here.
Spectroscopic Lab: The AC lab have almost all the Spectroscopic and optical devices used in B.Sc. honours
and B.Sc. general courses.
Higher Secondary Lab: This lab have almost all the device, and setup required for higher secondary physics
practical class.
 Apart from these Laboratories, department has one Astronomical Telescope used for sky observation.

                                    Department of Chemistry
       Established in the year 1995, the Department of Chemistry has been imparting Higher
Secondary courses under ASSEB and Under Graduate Courses (FYUG) in Chemistry under
Bodoland University. In the year 2023 Post Graduate Course M.Sc. Chemistry was started under
Bodoland University. The UG and PG courses are being run as per NEP 2020 curriculum as
implemented by Bodoland University. From the year 2025, Bodoland University has recognized the
Department as affiliated Research Lab and three Faculty members are recognized as Research
Supervisor for guiding Ph.D. scholars.
        Besides this, the Department have been organizing awareness and counselling Programme
for Joint Admission Test for Masters (JAM) and M.Sc. Entrance examinations for the students of
Sem-V of the department every Year. So far twelve students have cracked JAM and completed their
M.Sc. from IIT, NIT etc. and some are pursuing M.Sc. after cracking JAM. The Department also
organizes different activities like seminar, workshop and other departmental activities among the
students for their all-round development. The Department received the “Best Department” Award
for the Session 2018-2019. A total of Twenty (20) Students secured First Class in B.Sc. Final Exam,
since 2019.
        The primary moto of the Department is to create a cognitive environment in the distribution
of knowledge in the branch of Chemical education to generate quality human resources from this
locality to serve the country. The Department has five experiences, qualified and competent faculty
members and one highly professional and skilled contractual faculty member. All the members of
the Department is devoting to foster an academic culture of excellence in the college as well as to
uphold the highest standards in the chemical education.

                            Department of Mathematics
       The Department of Mathematics has been functioning since the establishment of the college
in 1995 and stands as one of its key academic departments. It follows the curriculum prescribed by
Bodoland University and offers both Major and Minor courses up to the B.Sc. level under the
semester system.
       The department is supported by a dedicated team of four teaching faculty members and one
non-teaching staff. It maintains a well-stocked departmental library, providing students and teachers
with access to a wide range of books for academic enrichment and self-study. In addition, the
department is equipped with a modern computer laboratory to support practical learning and
computational work.
        To encourage academic engagement beyond the classroom, the department publishes a wall
magazine titled “MATHEMATICA,” where important and interesting topics in Mathematics are
regularly displayed for readers. The department also maintains a photo gallery that preserves
